name: Aussie Broadband
summary: Regional Victorian ISP founded in Gippsland that grew into a major national RSP and ASX-listed telecom group.

events.details: Founded via amalgamation of Westvic Broadband and Wideband Networks (both trading since 2003).
ASX-listed (ASX:ABB) via IPO, admitted to the official list 16 Oct 2020.
